purpose: A TXL model with r=0 runs as ReadTxL's lossless line, and the card's LEN= is its length (SpiceRack P8-049: ESPice refused r=0).

oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 .meas values (7 significant digits, so up to 5e-8 relative rounding); ngspice-45 prints the same lines. A lossless line between matched 50 ohm ends is a pure delay of len*sqrt(L C): the far ends read 0 before 5 ns (Y1) and 10 ns (Y2) and 0.5 V after, the closed form in the deck header, which every value matches to ngspice's 0.1 gmin port stamp (-1.25e-12 V). Every sample sits on a flat plateau, so the 0.1 ns grid's interpolation adds nothing: rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-9 V. The model's length on Y2 would read 0.5 V at 8 ns (o2_8); the old refusal fails the run.
